name: Drooping prairie-coneflower
desc: Drooping prairie-coneflower (Ratibida pinnata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 13 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ratibida pinnata is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae known by the common names pinnate prairie coneflower, gray-head coneflower, yellow coneflower, and prairie coneflower.
